{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}

module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, MVar, newMVar, modifyMVar, modifyMVar_, readMVar)
import Control.Monad (forever, forM_)
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as BLC
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Network.WebSockets (ServerApp, acceptRequest, receiveData, sendTextData, runServer, Connection)
import Data.Aeson (FromJSON(..), ToJSON(..), decode, encode, Value(..), (.:), (.:?), withObject)
import Data.Aeson.Types (Parser)
import qualified Codec.Serialise as CBOR
import qualified Data.Binary as Binary
import Data.Typeable (Typeable)

-- | Chat message types for the real-time system
data MessageType = TextMsg | SystemMsg | SyncMsg | PluginMsg
  deriving (Show, Eq, Generic)

instance FromJSON MessageType
instance ToJSON MessageType

-- | Core chat message structure
data ChatMessage = ChatMessage
  { msgType    :: MessageType
  , sender     :: Text
  , channel    :: Text
  , content    :: Text
  , metadata   :: Maybe Value
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON ChatMessage
instance ToJSON ChatMessage

-- | Plugin action for extensibility (used in k8s sidecar pattern)
data PluginAction = PluginAction
  { actionName :: Text
  , actionData :: ByteString
  , serialFormat :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance CBOR.Serialise PluginAction
instance Binary.Binary PluginAction

-- | State synchronization payload for multi-pod consistency
data SyncPayload = SyncPayload
  { syncVersion :: Int
  , syncData    :: ByteString
  , syncCodec   :: Text  -- "json" | "cbor" | "binary"
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON SyncPayload where
  parseJSON = withObject "SyncPayload" $ \v -> SyncPayload
    <$> v .: "syncVersion"
    <*> (BLC.pack <$> (v .: "syncData"))
    <*> v .: "syncCodec"

instance ToJSON SyncPayload

-- | Server state
type ClientMap = Map Text Connection
data ServerState = ServerState
  { clients    :: ClientMap
  , msgHistory :: [ChatMessage]
  , syncState  :: Maybe SyncPayload
  , nextId     :: Int
  }

newServerState :: ServerState
newServerState = ServerState Map.empty [] Nothing 0

-- | Codec registry for deserialization dispatch
-- In production k8s, sidecars register codecs via gRPC
data CodecRegistry = CodecRegistry
  { codecHandlers :: Map Text (ByteString -> IO (Either String Value))
  }

defaultRegistry :: CodecRegistry
defaultRegistry = CodecRegistry $ Map.fromList
  [ ("json", \bs -> return $ maybe (Left "parse error") Right (decode bs))
  , ("cbor", decodeCBORPayload)
  , ("binary", decodeBinaryPayload)
  ]

-- | CBOR decoder - uses Codec.Serialise which is type-safe
decodeCBORPayload :: ByteString -> IO (Either String Value)
decodeCBORPayload bs = do
  let result = CBOR.deserialiseOrFail bs :: Either CBOR.DeserialiseFailure PluginAction
  case result of
    Left err -> return $ Left (show err)
    Right action -> executePluginAction action

-- | Binary decoder - uses Data.Binary
decodeBinaryPayload :: ByteString -> IO (Either String Value)
decodeBinaryPayload bs = do
  let result = Binary.decodeOrFail bs :: Either (ByteString, Binary.ByteOffset, String) (ByteString, Binary.ByteOffset, PluginAction)
  case result of
    Left (_, _, err) -> return $ Left err
    Right (_, _, action) -> executePluginAction action

-- | Execute a plugin action after deserialization
-- This is called from the codec pipeline after successful decode
-- Allowed actions are strictly enumerated with no shell interaction
executePluginAction :: PluginAction -> IO (Either String Value)
executePluginAction action = do
  case actionName action of
    "notify"    -> return $ Right (String "notification sent")
    "broadcast" -> return $ Right (String "broadcast queued")
    "health"    -> return $ Right (String "healthy")
    "exec"      -> do
      -- k8s liveness probe integration - returns static health status
      -- No shell commands; health is determined by application state
      return $ Right (String "probe complete")
    _           -> return $ Left "unknown action"

-- | Process incoming sync messages between pods
processSyncMessage :: CodecRegistry -> SyncPayload -> IO (Either String Value)
processSyncMessage registry payload = do
  let codec = syncCodec payload
  case Map.lookup codec (codecHandlers registry) of
    Nothing -> return $ Left $ "unsupported codec: " ++ T.unpack codec
    Just handler -> handler (syncData payload)

-- | Handle incoming WebSocket messages
handleMessage :: MVar ServerState -> CodecRegistry -> Connection -> Text -> ByteString -> IO ()
handleMessage state registry conn clientId raw = do
  case decode raw :: Maybe ChatMessage of
    Nothing -> sendTextData conn (encode $ ChatMessage SystemMsg "server" "" "invalid message format" Nothing)
    Just msg -> case msgType msg of
      TextMsg -> broadcastMessage state msg
      SystemMsg -> return ()  -- ignore client-sent system messages
      SyncMsg -> do
        case decode raw :: Maybe SyncPayload of
          Nothing -> return ()
          Just syncPl -> do
            result <- processSyncMessage registry syncPl
            case result of
              Left err -> sendTextData conn (BLC.pack err)
              Right val -> sendTextData conn (encode val)
      PluginMsg -> do
        -- Plugin messages use the metadata field for routing
        case metadata msg of
          Nothing -> return ()
          Just meta -> do
            case decode (encode meta) :: Maybe SyncPayload of
              Nothing -> return ()
              Just syncPl -> do
                result <- processSyncMessage registry syncPl
                case result of
                  Left err -> sendTextData conn (BLC.pack err)
                  Right val -> sendTextData conn (encode val)

-- | Broadcast a message to all connected clients
broadcastMessage :: MVar ServerState -> ChatMessage -> IO ()
broadcastMessage state msg = do
  st <- readMVar state
  forM_ (Map.elems (clients st)) $ \conn ->
    sendTextData conn (encode msg)
  modifyMVar_ state $ \s -> return s { msgHistory = msg : take 99 (msgHistory s) }

-- | WebSocket application handler
app :: MVar ServerState -> ServerApp
app state pending = do
  conn <- acceptRequest pending
  -- Generate a unique client ID from the live server state (atomically),
  -- rather than from the always-empty initial state.
  clientId <- modifyMVar state $ \s -> do
    let cid = "client_" <> T.pack (show (nextId s))
    return ( s { clients = Map.insert cid conn (clients s)
               , nextId  = nextId s + 1 }
           , cid )
  let registry = defaultRegistry
  forever $ do
    raw <- receiveData conn
    forkIO $ handleMessage state registry conn clientId raw

main :: IO ()
main = do
  state <- newMVar newServerState
  putStrLn "Chat server starting on port 9160 (k8s service: chat-realtime)"
  runServer "0.0.0.0" 9160 (app state)
